component_findings: IID: full v0.3 minus the no-restoration control changes persistent label-flip damage by -0.56 pp (nominal 95% interval -0.84 to -0.27). Lower damage favours restoration.
IID: full v0.3 minus the no-clipping control changes persistent label-flip damage by -0.45 pp (nominal 95% interval -0.71 to -0.18). Lower damage favours clipping.

IID: the memory-free directional rule minus capped RFA changes honest-stripe accuracy by +12.51 pp (nominal 95% interval +10.57 to +14.44) and persistent label-flip damage by +0.77 pp (nominal 95% interval +0.51 to +1.03). Higher accuracy and lower damage are desirable; the two outcomes expose a trade-off.
non-IID: full v0.3 minus the no-restoration control changes persistent label-flip damage by -4.57 pp (nominal 95% interval -8.11 to -1.04). Lower damage favours restoration.
non-IID: full v0.3 minus the no-clipping control changes persistent label-flip damage by -0.01 pp (nominal 95% interval -0.05 to +0.03). Lower damage favours clipping.

non-IID: the memory-free directional rule minus capped RFA changes honest-stripe accuracy by +2.63 pp (nominal 95% interval -0.32 to +5.58) and persistent label-flip damage by +8.38 pp (nominal 95% interval +4.79 to +11.98). Higher accuracy and lower damage are desirable; the two outcomes expose a trade-off.
conclusion: Practical point targets: 8/10. Joint target not met.
scope: Five paired blocks per regime on known MNIST. No simultaneous significance, unseen-dataset or established novelty claim.
